summary: the agentsaccept case of Claude Code on x86-64 against a kernel that does not tell terminal programs that their window changed size

argv: ARCH=x86_64 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 && ARCH=x86_64 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel
ARCH=x86_64 RACH2_ACCEPT_AGENTS=claude exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run agentsaccept 'agents-accept: PASS'

faults.name: winch
faults.summary: a pseudo-terminal's master sends no SIGWINCH when it sets the window size, as sshd does when the client's window changes, so the tmux client on the machine never learns the new size

lines: agents-accept: FAIL: claude: the resized terminal: got [120x39 120x39 1]
